title: [bug] Fresh Start: copying a budget with a bank-linked account collides on accounts_link_unique (reported by the budget-ou8p agent, not verified)
description: Reported while testing budget-ou8p: 'Fresh Start carries transactions only for linked accounts, and copying a linked account collides on accounts_link_unique'. Looks like an existing production problem; nobody has reproduced it independently. Reproduce on main with a budget that has a bank-linked account, then decide.
